Пульс прощупывают там, где артерия лежит: The pulse is felt where an artery runs close to the surface and can be pressed against bone or firm tissue. Each heartbeat sends a pressure wave along the artery walls (5–10 m/s), so at the foot it arrives about 0.2 s later than at the neck — watch the flashes. The pulse is usually counted at the radial artery: 60–90 beats per minute at rest. The carotid is felt on one side only and never pressed hard.
<b>Лимфоидная ткань кишки</b> — самая бо: Gut lymphoid tissue is the largest part of the immune system: the intestinal wall holds more lymphocytes than all lymph nodes together. Clusters of follicles in the ileum are called Peyer's patches: special M cells above them let samples of gut contents in, and the immune system learns to tell food and friendly bacteria from pathogens. Plasma cells that secrete IgA antibodies into the gut lumen also come from here.
<b>Куда стекает лимфа.</b> <span style=\: Where lymph drains. The right lymphatic duct drains the right half of the head, neck and chest and the right arm. The thoracic duct drains about ¾ of the body: it starts as the cisterna chyli at L1–L2 and empties into the left venous angle, where the jugular and subclavian veins join.
<b>Эпидермис</b> (0,05–1,5 мм) — многосл: The epidermis (0.05–1.5 mm) is a stratified epithelium without blood vessels. From the bottom up: the basal layer (cells divide), the spinous layer (cells held together by desmosome “spines”), the granular layer (keratohyalin granules; cells begin to die), on palms and soles also the clear layer, and the horny layer — dead flakes that are shed; the epidermis renews in about 4 weeks. Melanocytes sit in the basal layer: through their processes they hand the pigment melanin to neighbouring cells, where it shields the nuclei from ultraviolet. Everyone has roughly the same number of melanocytes; skin colour depends on how much melanin they make.
<b>Дерма</b> (1–4 мм) — соединительная т: The dermis (1–4 mm) is connective tissue of collagen fibers (strength) and elastin (elasticity). The thin papillary layer under the epidermis is loose and holds capillary loops and Meissner corpuscles; the thick reticular layer is dense, and its collagen holds the skin together. Vessels form two plexuses: a deep one at the border with the subcutis and a subpapillary one, from which loops rise into every papilla. The dermis contains vessels, nerves and receptors, hair roots, sebaceous and sweat glands. Dermal papillae form the ridges of fingerprints.
<b>Лейкоциты</b> — белые клетки с ядром,: White blood cells are nucleated cells, 4–9 thousand per µL. Neutrophils (up to 70%, segmented nucleus) are the first to reach an infection and eat bacteria. Lymphocytes (large round nucleus) are the B and T cells of immune memory. Monocytes (bean-shaped nucleus) enter tissues and become macrophages. Eosinophils (1–4%, two-lobed nucleus and orange granules) fight parasites and take part in allergy, basophils (under 1%, dark purple granules hide the nucleus) release histamine. A white cell is 1.5–2.5 times larger than a red cell. White cells can leave a vessel through its wall.
<b>Плазма</b> — 55% объёма крови: на 92%: Plasma is 55% of blood volume: 92% water, 7% proteins (albumins — 60% of the proteins — keep water in the vessels; globulins — 35%, including antibodies; fibrinogen — 4%, needed for clotting), plus glucose, salts, hormones and waste products. An adult has about 5 L of blood — 7–8% of body mass.
<b>Кровь в пробирке.</b> Если пробирку с: Blood in a test tube. Spin a tube of blood in a centrifuge and the cells settle: heavy red cells at the bottom (about 45% of the volume — the hematocrit), above them a thin whitish film of white cells and platelets (under 1%), and clear yellow plasma on top (about 55%). A low hematocrit points to anemia, a high one to thickened blood (dehydration, life at high altitude).
<b>Кровь</b> — жидкая ткань: плазма (55%: Blood is a liquid tissue: plasma (55%) and formed elements (45%). In an artery, cells flow faster in the centre and slower near the wall. The arterial wall has three layers: the intima (endothelium and elastic membrane), the media (smooth muscle) and the outer adventitia with its own vessels and nerve. Red cells carry gases, white cells defend, platelets stop bleeding. All of them are born in red bone marrow from stem cells. Click a cell.

Angina and heart-attack pain is felt behind the breastbone and on the left, spreading to the left arm along its inner side, to the neck and the lower jaw. Sensory fibers from the heart enter the spinal cord at T1–T4 — the same segments that receive nerves from the skin of the chest and the inner arm (C8–T1).

<b>Аппендицит, начало.</b> Тупая боль во: Appendicitis, onset. Dull pain around the navel or in the epigastrium, nausea. The swollen, inflamed appendix irritates visceral fibers that enter segment T10, and the brain refers the pain to the midline of the abdomen.
<b>Боль перемещается</b> в правую подвзд: The pain moves to the right iliac region, to McBurney's point (one third of the way from the anterior superior iliac spine to the navel). This migration of pain is a classic sign of appendicitis (Kocher's sign).
<b>Желчная колика.</b> Через час-два пос: Biliary colic. An hour or two after a fatty meal a stone blocks the gallbladder duct: severe pain in the right upper quadrant and epigastrium, nausea.
<b>Боль отдаёт</b> под правую лопатку и: The pain radiates under the right shoulder blade and to the right shoulder. The shoulder blade — through the shared thoracic segments T6–T9, the shoulder — through the phrenic nerve (C3–C5): the irritated diaphragm “complains” on the skin of the neck and shoulder. Pain lasting more than 6 hours with fever suggests inflammation of the gallbladder (cholecystitis).
<b>Почечная колика.</b> Камень застрял в: Renal colic. A stone is stuck in the renal pelvis or upper ureter: waves of very severe pain in the loin and flank. The patient writhes and cannot find a comfortable position — unlike peritonitis, where people lie still.
<b>Камень спускается</b> по мочеточнику,: The stone moves down the ureter and the pain follows it — to the groin, the inner thigh and the genitals. The ureter's segments run from T11 to L2, and each part “refers” to its own patch of skin.
<b>Отражённая боль.</b> Больной орган ча: Referred pain. A diseased organ often “hurts” not where it lies but on a patch of skin — a Head zone (Zakharyin–Head zone). Click an organ or choose it in the list to see its zone. Zones help doctors: pain in the left arm may mean a heart attack, pain in the shoulder — blood under the diaphragm.
<b>Почему боль «переезжает».</b> Чувстви: Why pain “moves”. Sensory fibers from an organ (red impulse) pass through the sympathetic trunk and dorsal root into the same spinal segment that receives fibers from the skin (blue impulse). Both converge on one dorsal horn neuron, and a shared pathway leads on to the brain. Signals from the skin arrive all life long, from the heart rarely, so the brain habitually attributes the pain to the skin.

\n <div><h2>Зоны Захарьина — Геда</:
Zakharyin–Head zones

In 1889 the physician G. A. Zakharyin in Moscow and in 1893 the neurologist Henry Head in London independently described how, in diseases of internal organs, certain patches of skin become tender and hypersensitive. These patches match dermatomes — strips of skin supplied by one spinal cord segment.

Visceral and somatic pain

Internal organs hardly feel cutting or burning but hurt when stretched, in spasm, inflamed or short of oxygen. Visceral pain is dull and poorly localized, often with nausea and sweating. The parietal peritoneum and pleura are innervated like the skin — their pain is sharp and precise.

Simplifications

  • Zones follow Netter's atlas (BP 13); they vary considerably between people.
  • The cardiac zone has been added: Netter does not show it on this plate.
  • Renal colic is shown on the left; it can occur on either side.
  • The spinal cord section is schematic and pathways are shortened.

This is not a self-diagnosis guide. Severe pain in the chest, abdomen or loin is a reason to see a doctor.

<b>Периферический нерв в разрезе.</b> Не: A peripheral nerve in cross-section. A nerve is a cable of thousands of axons. Each fiber is wrapped in thin endoneurium; fibers are gathered into fascicles covered by perineurium — a dense cell layer that acts as a blood–nerve barrier. Everything is wrapped in epineurium of dense connective tissue with fat and its own vessels. The white sleeves are myelin from Schwann cells. After an injury the surgeon sutures the nerve through the epineurium or the perineurium of the fascicles; axons regrow about 1 mm a day.
<b>Гипоталамус</b> — мост между нервной: The hypothalamus links the nervous and endocrine systems: its neurons release releasing hormones. The pituitary (0.5 g) is the “master gland”: the anterior lobe releases tropic hormones (TSH, ACTH, FSH, LH), growth hormone and prolactin; the posterior lobe only stores and releases vasopressin and oxytocin made by hypothalamic neurons.
The heart is an endocrine organ too. Atria stretched by excess blood release natriuretic peptide: the kidneys excrete more salt and water, vessels dilate and blood pressure falls. A test for the related peptide BNP helps detect heart failure.
<b>Почки</b> выделяют <b>эритропоэтин</b: The kidneys release erythropoietin (when oxygen is short, bone marrow makes more red cells), renin (starts the renin–angiotensin–aldosterone system that raises blood pressure) and turn vitamin D into active calcitriol, which boosts calcium absorption.
<b>Желудок и кишка</b> — самая большая э: The stomach and intestine form the largest endocrine “gland”: cells scattered in the mucosa release gastrin (stomach acid), secretin and cholecystokinin (pancreatic juice and bile), GIP and GLP-1 (boost insulin release after a meal — GLP-1 is the basis of modern drugs for diabetes and obesity) and ghrelin, the “hunger hormone”.

<b>Жировая ткань</b> выделяет <b>лептин<: Adipose tissue releases leptin: the more fat, the more leptin and the more the hypothalamus damps appetite; in obesity the brain stops hearing this signal. Adiponectin raises insulin sensitivity. Fat also makes estrogens.
<b>Сердце.</b> Боль при стенокардии и ин: Heart. Angina and heart-attack pain is felt behind the breastbone and on the left, spreading to the left arm along its inner side, to the neck and the lower jaw. Sensory fibers from the heart enter the spinal cord at T1–T4. The same segments receive nerves from the skin of the chest and the inner side of the arm and forearm (T1–T2, and C8 at the little finger). Radiation to the neck and jaw is linked to the vagus nerve and the cervical segments.
<b>Желудок и двенадцатиперстная кишка.</: Stomach and duodenum. Ulcer and gastritis pain is in the epigastric region, “in the pit of the stomach”, in the midline, although the stomach lies to the left. At the back the pain may be felt left of the spine, below the shoulder blade. Segments T6–T9.
<b>Печень.</b> Сама ткань печени почти н: Liver. Liver tissue itself hardly feels pain; the stretched capsule hurts: a dull ache in the right upper quadrant. If the diaphragm under the liver is irritated, pain goes to the right shoulder: the diaphragm is supplied by the phrenic nerve from cervical segments C3–C5, and the supraclavicular nerves from the same segments (C3–C4) supply the skin over the shoulder.
<b>Селезёнка.</b> Боль в <b>левом подреб: Spleen. Pain in the left upper quadrant; blood under the diaphragm from a ruptured spleen irritates the diaphragm and causes pain in the left shoulder (Kehr's sign).
<b>Боль отдаёт.</b> Она уходит в левую р: The pain spreads. It goes down the inner side of the left arm to the little finger, into the neck and lower jaw, sometimes to the epigastrium. In women, the elderly and people with diabetes the pain may be mild or only “in the stomach” — which is why such heart attacks are missed. Crushing chest pain lasting more than 5 minutes that does not ease at rest is a reason to call emergency services at once.
<b>Почему боль «переезжает».</b> Чувстви: Why pain “moves”. Sensory fibers from the heart (red impulse) run with the sympathetic nerves through the sympathetic trunk without stopping in its ganglia and reach the spinal nerve through the white ramus communicans. The cell body of this neuron lies in the dorsal root ganglion, and it synapses in the dorsal horn of the same segment that receives fibers from the skin (blue impulse). Both converge on one dorsal horn neuron; its axon crosses to the other side and ascends in the spinothalamic tract to the thalamus. Signals from the skin arrive all life long, from the heart rarely, so the brain habitually attributes the pain to the skin.

\n <div><h2>Два уровня защиты</h2>\:
Two levels of defense

Innate immunity works immediately and in the same way against everything: skin and mucous membranes, phagocytes (neutrophils, macrophages), inflammation, interferons. Adaptive immunity is specific and has memory: B lymphocytes release antibodies, killer T cells destroy infected cells, helper T cells coordinate the response.

Vaccination

A vaccine creates memory cells without the disease. The first vaccine (against smallpox) was introduced by Edward Jenner in 1796; the theory of phagocytosis was proposed by Ilya Mechnikov (Nobel Prize, 1908).

<b>Подкожная жировая клетчатка</b> — зап: Subcutaneous fat is an energy store, insulation and a shock absorber. Its thickness varies greatly between body sites and between people. Fat lobules are separated by connective-tissue strands that tie the skin to the deep fascia; the subcutaneous artery and vein and the trunk of the cutaneous nerve run here, with twigs rising to the receptors.
